title: MASTER-REGISTER
universal_lens: The Master Register formalizes a topological state-space partitioning problem. The VM constitutes an observable subspace, while 'UNACCOUNTED' domains represent hidden variables outside the local sigma-algebra. Systemic integrity relies on mapping disjointed file-trees and API endpoints to a unified algebraic structure, minimizing epistemic leakage across isolated agent boundaries.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats UNACCOUNTED gaps as missing data in a high-dimensional Bayesian network. Conformal prediction intervals are constructed over the visible `~/workspace/goals/` to bound uncertainty. When external workloads (e.g., Google Gemini) lack schema visibility, GSI flags these as structural priors requiring explicit telemetry injection to maintain calibration.
gse_mapping: GSE models the inventory as a Markov Decision Process where states transition between ✅ WIRED and 🔴 UNACCOUNTED. Situational reasoning requires dispatching specific WHO/WHAT queries to collapse the wavefunction of invisible workspaces (like Hermes), ensuring the global control loop maintains strict causal ordering across distributed compute nodes.
